clues.it: Vito era accanto a una balla di fieno, in una stanza diversa da Sergio e in Banca.
clues.en: Vito was beside a hay bale, in a different room from Sergio and in the Bank.

clues.it: Elena era nella 2ª colonna e accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Elena was in the 2nd column and beside a saloon stool.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 6ª colonna e nella 3ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 6th column and in the 3rd row, but was not beside a saddle.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Ugo era da solo alla Stazione, ma non era accanto a un carro.
clues.en: Ugo was alone at the Depot, but was not beside a wagon.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un abbeveratoio e a nord di Rosa.
clues.en: Luca was beside a water trough and north of Rosa.

clues.it: Carla era nella 7ª riga e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Carla was in the 7th row and west of Ugo.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 11ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 11th column, in the 8th row and north of Marta.

clues.it: Rosa era a ovest di Fabio e nel Saloon.
clues.en: Rosa was west of Fabio and in the Saloon.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 13ª colonna e nella 10ª riga, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 13th column and in the 10th row, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª colonna, nella 11ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th column, in the 11th row and in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Nino era in una stanza diversa da Sergio e nel Saloon.
clues.en: Nino was in a different room from Sergio and in the Saloon.

clues.it: Marta era nella 4ª colonna, nella 13ª riga e a ovest di Sergio.
clues.en: Marta was in the 4th column, in the 13th row and west of Sergio.

steps.en: Elena can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Stables” cannot add up without Carla: they must be at row 7th, column 3rd.
